# sigma_user_attribute (Data Source)

Retrieves a Sigma user attribute by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sigma_user_attribute" "example" {
  id = "user-attribute-id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) User attribute ID.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `created_by` (String) Member ID that created the user attribute.
- `default_value` (String) Default string value.
- `description` (String) User attribute description.
- `name` (String) User attribute name.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
- `updated_by` (String) Member ID that last updated the user attribute.
